title: Tile upscale in the upscale op (Use Tiles)
description: Use Tiles beside Use Grid in every model's upscale op: Impact 1024 tiles + the model's own detailer settings, 1.0x = detail only, tile count in the label. Krea2 first (Fabio's bench wiring), then Klein/Chroma/SDXL; Qwen 2.1 later. The Tile Detailer Flow is removed.
